overview: Once Human's world (Nalcott) is divided into major regions, each centered on a Stronghold and gated by recommended enemy level. Later seasons add separate Visional Worlds / Strange Worlds layered on top of the base map.

otherNotableAreas.name: Broken Delta
otherNotableAreas.notes: Home to the Gaia Cliff Monolith and the Treant boss.

otherNotableAreas.name: Iron River
otherNotableAreas.notes: Home to the Mirage Monolith and the Arachsiam boss.

otherNotableAreas.name: Chalk Peak
otherNotableAreas.notes: Home to the Monolith of Thirst and the Rabizex boss; terrain adjusted near here in patch 2.4.1.

otherNotableAreas.name: Red Sands
otherNotableAreas.notes: Home to the Forsaken Monolith and Mensdevoran.

specialWorldsAndScenarios.name: Way of Winter
specialWorldsAndScenarios.notes: Added winter-themed Deviants (tagged WoT in this database) and mechanics.

specialWorldsAndScenarios.name: Gravity Abyss (Visional Wheel S4)
specialWorldsAndScenarios.notes: Zero-gravity combat across floating islands; home of the Riftwalker boss. Added in patch 2.4.1.

specialWorldsAndScenarios.name: Pixel-Style Strange World / Block Island / Wish Island
specialWorldsAndScenarios.notes: A blocky, pixel-art version of Nalcott; setting for the Block Adventure event in patch 3.0.3.

specialWorldsAndScenarios.name: Eternaland
specialWorldsAndScenarios.notes: Endgame scenario/mode referenced alongside Endless Dream and Evolution's Call.
